The governor gave the warning on Wednesday in Keffi while inaugurating the campaign council of the APC senatorial candidate for Nasarawa West, Dr. Faisal Shuaib.
“Most times, we create enemies as a result of rumours and suspicions. Sometimes, even when I hear something, I don’t act until I establish the truth. That is how we can move on,” Sule said.
He told party leaders, stakeholders and campaign officials at the event that unity was no longer a slogan but a condition for survival ahead of the 2027 general elections.
According to him, the APC in Nasarawa West cannot afford to go into the election divided, with supporters working at cross-purposes and camps tearing each other down.
He urged the newly inaugurated council to work for all APC candidates, and not to concentrate its energy on individual ambitions.
“Elections are won and lost at the polling units and at the wards. So, when you are empowering people at the ward level, you are empowering the right people,” he said.
Sule commended Dr. Shuaib for providing financial and logistical support to the campaign council, noting that strengthening party structures at ward and polling unit levels was the surest path to victory.
In his remarks, Dr. Shuaib said his campaign would pursue a collective APC victory, from the presidential election to the State House of Assembly.
“APC Sak means we deliver our presidential candidate, Asiwaju Bola Ahmed Tinubu; Senator Ahmed Aliyu Wadada as the next governor of Nasarawa State; and win the Senate, House of Representatives and State House of Assembly seats,” he said.
To back his pledge, Shuaib announced N81.65 million in financial support for grassroots mobilisation, 15 operational vehicles for local government coordinators and 124 motorcycles for ward coordinators and other stakeholders across the five local government areas.
He described the resources as tools for work, not gifts for loyalty.
“These are not gifts; they are tools. We have given you the tools, now give us the results,” he said.
Dr. Shuaib said his proposed representation would be guided by the DFS CARES agenda, focusing on community development, agriculture, poverty alleviation, education, healthcare, women and youth empowerment, skills development and security.
Former Governor and former APC National Chairman, Senator Abdullahi Adamu, also called for fairness, justice and sustained party unity, urging stakeholders to support all APC candidates and avoid abandoning anyone in the political process.
The APC State Chairman, Dr. Aliyu Bello, urged party members to remain loyal and shun anti-party activities, while calling on women to take their rightful place in the party’s activities.
